title: Thai Falafel Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad with crispy Thai-style falafel, sweet dates, and a tangy dressing.
instructions: 2. Bake the falafel for 12-15 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
3. In a large bowl, combine the chopped cilantro, sliced red onion, and sliced bell pepper.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the nightshade-free sauce, coconut oil, and red chili flakes.
5. Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss to combine.
6. Add the baked falafel to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
7. Top with chopped dates and serve immediately.
8. Garnish with additional cilantro and chili flakes, if desired.
